claim: Slow or unreliable third-party calls do not run inside a request.
Retry server faults. Record client faults.
Application code stays off the chain.
Reports read a read model, not the collection the workers write.
Counters change by an atomic update, never read-modify-write.
A new network plugs into the registry. The core does not change.
Local development runs the real dependencies.
Reproduce a failure before fixing it.
